warning: This v1.0 dataset is a machine-readable engineering baseline for the SIH26034 Rule Engine. It is not a legal opinion and is not a complete enforcement corpus. Rule 26 exact current exemptions/provisos, commodity-specific schedules, cross-regulatory requirements, and exact operational effect of the 2026 Third Amendment require authoritative source ingestion/legal review before production enforcement.

classification.MANDATORY: Applies when the rule conditions are satisfied and the requirement is legally required.
classification.CONDITIONAL: Requires a trigger/condition before becoming applicable.
classification.NOT_APPLICABLE: Does not govern the current context after exclusions/exemptions are evaluated.
classification.OPTIONAL: Permitted but not mandatory under the cited provision.
classification.REQUIRES_INSPECTOR_REVIEW: Facts or legal interpretation are insufficient for safe automatic enforcement.

architecture_principles: AI/OCR extracts package observations; it does not decide legal applicability.
Deterministic Rule Engine resolves context, scope exclusions, exemptions, effective version, and applicable requirements.
Inspector, Legal Metrology verifies evidence and makes the final legal finding.
Future-effective rules are inactive for current inspections.
MRP declaration and sale-above-MRP are separate checks.
Package declaration checks are distinct from physical quantity measurement checks.
Rule 26 and other exemptions are first-class applicability pathways.
